long_biography.plain_text:
Rossoneri Sport Investment Lux completed its purchase of Fininvest's 99.93% holding in AC Milan in April 2017. The deal placed Li Yonghong at the head of one of European football's best-known clubs. As chairman, he represented the Chinese ownership group until control passed to a new shareholder in July 2018.

Li is his family name and Yonghong his given name under Chinese naming conventions. His commercial career before the football acquisition remains obscure, and no present-day operating company is widely associated with him. The Milan investment consequently offers the clearest outline of his public career, but it does not explain his broader business history or how the investment capital was accumulated.
